entries.95450e94d7bb0a76: The company runs three businesses: the video-related business, which handles film exhibition, distribution and production; the food and beverage-related business, which operates restaurants including the yakitori specialty chain 'Kushidori'; and the real estate-related business, which leases real estate and resells refurbished used condominiums.
entries.997e04f5a1974185: Under its medium-term management policy, with the theme 'Innovation into a Producing Company', it is advancing a shift to a 'Human Resource-Type Business' in which it develops and creates products and services in-house in line with consumer needs. For its core businesses, it lists: redefining the business domain in the video-related business from 'film' to 'video entertainment'; expanding production capacity in the food and beverage-related business through construction of a central kitchen for the yakitori specialty restaurant 'Kushidori' and growing earnings from the takeout food business; and building a mechanism to stably achieve purchases and sales of up to 300 cases a year in the refurbished used condominium resale business.

It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

entries.c490df4a71a853d2: The foundations supporting each business are: leasing its owned properties in central Tokyo, including the Shinjuku Theatre Building, and maintaining an occupancy rate close to 100% through detailed leasing activities; expanding the yakitori specialty restaurant 'Kushidori', centered on the Sapporo area, including takeout specialty stores; and a track record in movie theater operation, having accepted entrusted operation of movie theaters in commercial facilities since 1993.
entries.cc742474e7cb3ed1: The real estate-related business accounts for more than half of revenue, while the video-related business, the company's starting point, has the smallest share of the three businesses. Its medium-term management policy lists the restructuring of that video business as one of the main policies among its core businesses.
entries.cefe843b0f4f3dfe: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,655 million (up 12.3% year on year). By business, the real estate-related business was ¥11,076 million, the food and beverage-related business ¥6,121 million, and the video-related business ¥3,457 million.
entries.db21d2296ab8e328: This business leases real estate, resells refurbished used condominiums and renovates condominiums and other properties; for the fiscal year ended March 2026, its revenue from external customers was ¥11,076 million, making it the largest business. The company is responsible for leasing and the resale of refurbished used condominiums, and Tokyo Theatres Remodeling Co., Ltd. undertakes renovation of condominiums and other properties under contract from the company. Rental properties maintained occupancy rates close to 100%, and the number of properties sold in the resale of refurbished used condominiums grew significantly in the current fiscal year.
entries.de400aa23fe14488: The company is headquartered in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group of six companies together with five consolidated subsidiaries. The consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is 437.
entries.e262bc8da8064c85: Customers include individuals such as movie theater visitors and restaurant patrons, as well as companies that order advertising and events, tenants of rental properties, and buyers of used condominiums.
